description: Unit test class for the ThingModifiedStrategy, testing immutability and application of ThingModified events to Thing objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.things.persistence.actors.strategies.events package.

classes.name: ThingModifiedStrategyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior and immutability of the ThingModifiedStrategy class in handling ThingModified events.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of ThingModifiedStrategy are immutable.

methods.name: appliesEventCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies that the handle() method correctly applies a ThingModified event to a Thing, producing the expected modified state.

methods.name: replacesPreviousMetadata
methods.description: Checks that the handle() method replaces previous metadata with new metadata when applying a ThingModified event.
